calculation.description: Ranks assets for next-day reversal using the negative trailing three-session return, scaled by recent 20-session volatility. The additive floor limits extreme values when volatility is very low. Signal is computed only through the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.046682), 2023-2024 (+0.025609), and 2025-2027 (+0.035387). Five-day IC was +0.017979 and ten-day IC -0.001450, indicating rapid decay and suitability primarily for one-day signal use. Small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
